outcome: Perivascular space of nonparenchymal blood vessels
Lumen size of nonparenchymal blood vessels
cohort: Preterm rabbit pups (gestation day 28) were obtained by cesarean section and exposed to either normoxic (21% O2) or hyperoxic (95% O2) conditions.
finding: Exposure to hyperoxia in preterm rabbit pups leads to reduced lung function, pulmonary hypertension, and specific lung structural changes (reduced alveolar number/surface area, thickened septa, inflammation, vascular remodeling) consistent with human bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD).
